name: Regal Behemoth
oracle_text:
Trample
When this creature enters, you become the monarch.
Whenever you tap a land for mana while you're the monarch, add an additional one mana of any color.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you tap a land for mana while you're the monarch, add an additional one mana of any color.

needs.what: an add_mana_on_tap payload meaning 'one mana of any color', chosen by the tapping player each time the triggered mana ability resolves (605.1b), e.g. add_mana: {"any_color": 1}, with the mana solver and payment treating it as a wildcard pip. Here combined with tapped_permanent {types: ["Land"]}, affects_player "you" and condition {is_monarch: ...}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_mana_on_tap with tapped_permanent {types: [Land]} and an is_monarch static condition covers the trigger and the 'while you're the monarch' clause, but its add_mana accepts only a literal production string or {"chosen_color_of": "self"}; player_statics._mana_added parses a literal and runs inside cost payment where no choice can be asked. A fixed '{G}' would be a different, narrower card
